title: Cervical cytology every 3 years, women 21-29

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for cervical cancer every 3 years with cervical cytology alone in women aged 21 to 29 years.

numerator.quote: every 3 years with cervical cytology alone

gold_notes: 30-65 arm (cytology q3y OR hrHPV q5y OR cotest q5y) is a second gold-worthy rule not authored here. Hysterectomy exclusion is not in this text.
